industry: Industrial and Commercial Machinery and Computer Equipment

machinery_computer_equipment_category.label: Machinery / computer-equipment category
machinery_computer_equipment_category.value: HVAC equipment (cooling towers, fans, boilers, electric heaters, air handlers) plus detection, inspection and fare-collection equipment

aftermarket_sales_mix.label: Aftermarket sales mix
aftermarket_sales_mix.value: Mainly new equipment sales, with a meaningful aftermarket parts and services stream, notably cooling tower parts and technical services

engineering_customization.label: Engineering / customization
engineering_customization.value: Highly engineered products; custom and modular air handlers alongside standard branded boilers, heaters and fans

service_maintenance_requirement.label: Service / maintenance requirement
service_maintenance_requirement.value: Technical services and aftermarket parts support for installed equipment; boilers serviced via licensed contractors

notes: Installed base, replacement cycle and maintenance cadence are not quantified in the evidence.
